name: workspace
//: Repo-level targets: the coverage aggregate over every crate's test profiles, the supply-chain check, and the reconciling checks over root-owned files (lint: project boundaries, the CI workflow contract, the restated coverage floor) with their tests (the justfile's gate recipes, the pre-push hook, the checkers). It depends on every other project ("*"), so any change selects it — which is what makes the coverage aggregate always see a complete set of profiles. The scripts' own tests live in the scripts project.

coverage.//: Runs the test target of every project this one depends on (all of them, via implicitDependencies "*"), so a new crate's profiles join the union with no list to update; then merges the raw profiles and enforces the 95% line floor over the gh-secrets crate's own sources (src/), once.
